Tornatore is a scriptwriter who appears next to Ragunna's Pioneer Association, after the completion of [[Carlotta]] Companion Quest; [[If On a Rainy Night a Family]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tornatore:''' "The rain poured relentlessly, cloaking the world in a shroud of gloom, stripping away its pretense of grandeur to reveal its barren core."

:'''Tornatore:''' "Under the storm's shadow, people were fighting at each other's throats—fragile yet ferocious, like... like beasts cornered in a cage." No, no, Tornatore, that's far too trite! Think, man! You can craft something better!

:'''Tornatore:''' You're the playwright of this drama. Give it an ending that lingers, and echo that won't fade!

:'''Tornatore:''' "As she fell, her trembling hand raised the gun. The old acquiantance{{sic}}, a traitor to his ideals, stared down the barrel. One last shot. Addio." Hmm, does that come across too... passive?

:'''Tornatore:''' Ah, I see. Rumors, ripe and waiting, a wellspring of inspiration at my fingertips. Let's see... "Can I really trust {{MC|m=him|f=her}}? She wondered. Yet instinct urged her forward. She clasped {{MC|m=him|f=her}} hand firmly, then turned her back, offering it wholly to her new companion." Yes, yes, that has promise!

:The creator in front of you is completely consumed by the tale of storm and betrayal he's spinning. Perhaps it's best to let him remain in his trance.
{{Dialogue End}}
